new_opening_paragraph: Hand-embroidered Lucknowi Chikankari, made for celebrations. This 2-piece suit pairs a long handwork kurti with matching embroidered pants, both in soft mul cotton, and comes in rani pink or sky blue. The floral needlework is done by hand, so the set drapes softly and feels as good as it looks at pujas, festive lunches and family functions.

A fresh lime green kurti with white Lucknowi Chikankari worked by hand. The floral motifs and traditional needlework stand out crisply against the colour, and the breathable cotton keeps it comfortable from a long office day to an evening get-together.

Deep maroon cotton with white Chikankari hand embroidery: a classic Lucknowi combination that never dates. This long kurti is made in breathable pure cotton, so it works for daily wear as easily as for festive days.

Navy blue mul cotton, finished with hand-embroidered Lucknowi Chikankari. Floral thread work runs across the yoke and body, with small button details at the front. It's a quiet, polished kurti that stays cool from morning to night.

Grey Gaji silk with a soft, rich texture, detailed with Mushroo thread embroidery and hand-set mirror work. This kurti looks understated at first glance and catches the light as you move, which makes it a good pick for evening functions and festive gatherings.

Ajrakh hand-block print meets Kutchi embroidery on lustrous silk. The long kurti carries traditional Ajrakh motifs from Kutch, with mirror work and thread embroidery around the neckline. It drapes beautifully and makes a statement at festivals and cultural events.

Soft pink mul cotton, hand-block printed with traditional Jaipuri florals. This 3-piece suit set comes with a matching kurta, pants and a flowing dupatta, and it is light enough for summer celebrations and daytime get-togethers. Shown here on one of our customers.

Rich brown with Bandhani motifs, an Anarkali flare and hand embroidery. This 3-piece suit set is made in luxe mul cotton and comes with a matching statement dupatta. The flowy silhouette keeps it comfortable through long festive days.

Pastel pink or lavender, with tonal hand embroidery on a long kurti and matching pants. This 2-piece suit is made in smooth rayon that drapes well and stays comfortable all day, making it an easy choice for casual outings and daytime gatherings.

A minimal summer kurta set in ivory mul cotton. The sleeveless, straight-cut kurta has tie-up shoulder straps and delicate floral embroidery, and comes with matching wide-leg pants. Cool, easy and made for warm, sunny days.

Crimson mul cotton with hand embroidery, mirror work and mandala motifs on the yoke. This 3-piece set pairs the kurta and matching pants with a contrast hand-block printed dupatta finished with tassels, for a festive look that still feels light.

An all-over botanical print in pure cotton, with a contrast indigo yoke, buttons and pleats. This co-ord set is breathable and easy to wear, and works as well for a relaxed day out as for a casual festive gathering.

Earthy olive green Leheriya, the diagonal tie-dye stripes Rajasthan is known for. The V-neckline is finished with mirror work and pink tassels, and the set comes with matching pants and a border-detailed dupatta, all in soft mul cotton.

Vibrant royal blue Leheriya stripes on feather-light mul cotton. The kurta has a pleated neck yoke and accent ties, and comes with printed pants and a large Leheriya-Bandhani dupatta: Rajasthani tie-dye, made for everyday wear.

Sunshine yellow mul cotton with a flared kurta and traditional yoke embroidery. Light and breathable, this 3-piece suit set comes with matching pants and a flowing dupatta, ready for festive mornings, pujas and summer functions.

A soft pastel suit set in feather-light mul cotton. The flared kurta has floral embroidery on the yoke and sleeves and subtle block-printed motifs, and comes with matching pants and a light, flowing dupatta.

Bright parrot green mul cotton with floral yoke embroidery and playful tassels. The straight-cut kurta, matching pants and light dupatta make a cheerful, easy set for casual days and festive celebrations.

Fine vertical stripes, a flared kurta and a rich block-printed floral border. This maroon 3-piece suit set in mul cotton adds yoke embroidery and mirror detailing, and comes with matching pants and a large printed dupatta.

Black mul cotton with a flared kurta, V-neckline, detailed yoke and tassel ties. The matching pants have a printed border and the dupatta is richly block-printed, so this 3-piece suit set looks festive while staying light.

Olive green mul cotton with a contrast-printed yoke, mirror work and a row of tassels along the neckline. The straight-cut kurti comes with matching wide-leg pants with printed hems, for an easy everyday 2-piece suit.

Navy blue mul cotton with an embroidered yoke of traditional animal motifs, hand embroidery and mandala details. The straight-cut kurta comes with matching pants and a contrast block-printed dupatta finished with tassels.

Black mul cotton with white geometric embroidery around the neckline, hem and sleeves. The straight-cut tunic has a buttoned placket, and the matching pants carry the same embroidery at the sides. Minimal, modern and breathable.

Ivory mul cotton scattered with crimson hand-block printed florals. The straight-cut kurti has a mandarin-style V-neck with fine pintucks and comes with matching relaxed pants, for a light, everyday 2-piece suit.

Choose maroon or olive green: this mul cotton 3-piece suit set has a geometric embroidered yoke with mirror work, mandala motifs and tassels. It comes with matching pants and a contrast dupatta in traditional hand-block prints.

A sleeveless black co-ord in breathable mul cotton. The collared, button-front tunic has two chest pockets, white contrast topstitching and a fabric tie-belt, and comes with wide-leg pants finished with matching hem stitching.

A smart black 2-piece suit for work days. The long-sleeved mul cotton tunic has a shirt collar, full button placket, white contrast topstitching and pleats on the yoke, with matching pants finished in crisp hem stitching.

A mul cotton shirt covered in Kutchi-inspired geometric and floral block prints in rust orange, black and royal blue. It has a classic collar, full button placket and long cuffed sleeves, with handcrafted beadwork and red tassels at the neckline. Wear it with trousers or jeans for an easy fusion look.

Soothing teal-green mul cotton with traditional block-printed motifs. The straight-cut kurta has a V-neck with yoke embroidery, subtle mirror work and fabric buttons, and comes with matching printed pants and a light dupatta.

White mul cotton with scattered floral block prints and printed side panels. The straight-cut kurti has a notched V-neck with contrast stitching and comes with matching relaxed pants: light, fresh and easy for everyday wear.

A wine-coloured short kurti in mul cotton, with tonal Lucknowi Chikankari embroidery on the yoke and scattered across the body. The round neckline has a slit, and the short length pairs easily with jeans, trousers or ethnic bottoms.

Black mul cotton with block-printed bootis and zigzag borders at the hem. The straight-cut kurti has a mandarin-style V-neck with contrast pintucks and three-quarter sleeves with chevron cuffs, and comes with matching relaxed pants.

Off-white mul cotton embroidered with little deer and floral stems at the yoke and hem. The straight-cut tunic has a mandarin collar and buttoned placket, and comes with matching relaxed pants: playful, light and easy to wear.

A short olive green cotton tunic with smocked pleating and bead accents on the yoke. It has a mandarin collar, a short button placket and white embroidery panels on the sleeves and hem. Pair it with jeans or pants.

An off-white cotton short tunic with large dark brown floral appliqué across the front. It has a mandarin collar, a partial button placket and three-quarter sleeves, for a clean, artistic everyday look.

A long cotton shrug made from panels of Kutchi-style hand-block prints in indigo, maroon, mustard and black. It has a collar, three-quarter sleeves and a gathered waist with tie strings. Throw it over a simple top and trousers or a plain dress.

An off-white cotton short tunic with bold black embroidered floral stems on the lower front. The V-neck is framed with black stitching and small dangling beads, giving a simple tunic an artistic finish.

Warm mustard mul cotton with traditional block-printed motifs. The straight-cut kurta has a square neckline with yoke stitching, mirror work and tassels, and comes with matching pants and a block-printed dupatta.

Easy white pants in pure mul cotton with a soft, natural crinkle. The relaxed straight wide leg falls to the ankle, and the elastic gathered waist keeps them comfortable all day. They go with almost every kurti, tunic and shirt.
Relaxed maroon pants in pure mul cotton with a soft, natural crinkle. A straight wide leg, ankle length and an elastic gathered waist make them an easy partner for white, cream and printed kurtis.

Black pure mul cotton pants with a soft crinkle texture, a relaxed straight wide leg and an elastic gathered waist. Light, breathable and ankle-length, they're an everyday base for kurtis, tunics and shirts.

Hand-stitched grid lines and embroidered florals on a rich chocolate maroon. Made in soft, breathable cotton, this co-ord set features a sleeveless, slightly A-line hip-length kurta in a striking chocolate maroon shade, detailed with a simple round neckline, delicate side slits, and hand-stitched cream grid lines framing charming hand-embroidered floral motifs across 12 distinct squares. Paired with matching relaxed straight wide-leg trousers in the same chocolate maroon hue and designed with an easy elastic waistband for all-day comfort, this artisanal set brings timeless sophistication and artistic flair to your festive and everyday wardrobe.

A festive patchwork shirt in reds, pinks and black, made in lightweight Chanderi with a soft, natural sheen that stays breathable all day. Designed with a relaxed, slightly boxy hip-length fit, a gently curved hem, and three-quarter sleeves, it features a classic pointed shirt collar in vibrant hot pink and a striking V-shaped printed border edged in black, beautifully accented with dangling gold coin charms (sikka). Complete with a deep black-purple yoke adorned with tiny white and pink floral prints, sleeves in contrasting red and hot pink featuring teardrop paisley motifs, and vertical patchwork panels in shades of black, red, pink, and hot pink, this artisanal shirt brings timeless charm and artistic flair to your festive and everyday wardrobe.

Fine block-printed paisley stripes and a bold geometric yoke on light Chanderi with a soft, natural sheen. This off-white 3-piece suit set features a straight long kurta reaching just below the knee, complete with a classic round neckline, elbow-length sleeves, and side slits. The off-white body is beautifully printed with thin vertical stripes made of small black-brown block-print swirling paisleys and tiny geometric blocks. It is highlighted by a distinctive rectangular yoke panel on the chest—featuring a red, pink, and cream diamond geometric print on the left and a black half with an orange and cream floral vine on the right—anchored by a mustard-yellow band with a paisley motif and framed by a thin orange-pink border. The sleeves and hem are finished with a wide band of matching maroon-red, mustard, and cream diamond print.

Rajasthani folk embroidery on warm mustard-ochre cotton. This soft, breathable co-ord set features a long, slightly A-line kurta with a mandarin band collar, brown wooden buttons, and three-quarter embroidered cuffs. It showcases traditional Rajasthani line-style embroidery depicting a decorated horse on the chest and a folk-style lady with a cascading peacock tail on the lower front. Paired with matching relaxed wide-leg trousers, this versatile set brings warm earthy richness and sophisticated artistry to your wardrobe.
